name: Repair shop with a hidden backroom
description: Broken devices come in (more on busy days, fewer on quiet ones, and now and then a crowd), a technician repairs them, and customers pick them up. That is all the model shows. What it does not show: about a third of the devices are ones the shop cannot fix, and they quietly go out the back to a vendor and come back, repaired, 12 to 18 hours later. Those are hidden flows, and the devices at the vendor are a stock nobody measures. Run it for a couple of hundred hours, then use Discover flows: with the measured flows subtracted, it should find something leaving Intake and something arriving in Ready for pickup, and suggest they are one hidden stock with a delay between them.

machines.name: Technician
machines.description: One technician; each repair takes about 27 minutes (0.45 of an hour).
